Output exactly five brief factual sentences, in order: adoption, failed amendments, Algerian reservation, Swiss amendment votes and reason, mandate limits. Spend no words on a title, introduction, or analysis of your task. Aim for at most 115 words in total. Use the evidence to check each sentence and cite a short source ID. Drafts are provisional. Distinguish formal Council acts, proposals, and national positions.

They received 6–0–9 and 5–0–10 respectively and neither secured enough votes to be adopted.", "TEXT": "Resolution 2756 extended the MINURSO mandate until 31 October 2025 and urged increased cooperation with OHCHR, including facilitating visits. output: Resolution 2756 (2024) was adopted by 12 votes in favor, zero against, and two abstentions (MAIN). Algeria proposed two amendments regarding OHCHR visits and MINURSO monitoring, which failed by 6–0–9 and 5–0–10 (AMEND). Algeria formally abstained from the final vote, citing disregard for its views on the Sahrawi people (DZ-B). Switzerland voted in favor of the resolution and abstained on the monitoring amendment to ensure mission continuity (CH-A). The adopted text authorized MINURSO until 31 October 2025 and urged cooperation with OHCHR without new monitoring functions (TEXT).
